The top prize count on "PREMIER PLAY" has not moved since we started watching it. The game still has three of three top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

PREMIER PLAY's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

Everything here about "PREMIER PLAY" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 18.
2414.headline: Top prizes are still unclaimed

2415.body:
About half of the tickets for "Double The Money" have been sold. The game is about halfway through its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Tomorrow's count on "Double The Money" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2415.headline: Where this game is in its run

2416.body:
"Loaded with $2,000s" has 62,704 prizes of $20 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $500 prize, with 1,040 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "Loaded with $2,000s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2416.headline: What the prize table shows

2419.body:
About two-thirds of the tickets for "Bronze 7s" have been sold. The game is past the halfway point of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

If you play "Bronze 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2419.headline: How far along this game is

2420.body:
About half of the tickets for "Silver 7s" have been sold. The game is about halfway through its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

Today's free summary of "Silver 7s" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2420.headline: Tickets sold so far

2421.body:
"Gold 7s" is near the midpoint of its run, with about two-thirds of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, top prizes are going faster than tickets, which is not a good sign.

Everything here about "Gold 7s" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 18.
2421.headline: How far along this game is

2422.body:
Platinum 7s's prizes make it a game with money in both small and large prizes. Of the prize money still unclaimed, about two-thirds is in wins under $2,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

If you play "Platinum 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
